claim: The workbook is free to use and its source is MIT-licensed
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; create a real workbook, save an edit, export without any account or payment step, and assert the shipped MIT license

claim: The demo opens a sample workbook with three completed trails, resets, and never replaces a real workbook
where: landing demo action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; assert three ready trails, create named real work, re-enter/edit/reset demo, exit, and assert the exact real workbook survives while demo:current is removed

claim: Records the search query, rejected result, checked source, credibility notes, claim, quotation, and evidence link in one review-ready trail
where: landing headline and three steps, workbook, README
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; enter real mode, complete every part of a trail, and assert the ready state and saved rejected result

claim: Exports the complete workbook as JSON
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; download and parse JSON; assert three complete trails

claim: Exports every trail as a CSV table
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; download CSV; assert header and one row per sample trail
fresh /?demo=1; download citations; assert style warning and all three sample sources

claim: Exports a blank assignment template that can be imported
where: instructor section, workbook export menu, README
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; download template, import it into real mode, and assert question retained while student work is blank

claim: Importing valid workbook JSON asks before replacing the workbook saved in the browser
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; create and save real work, reject an import and assert it survives, then accept and assert imported content replaces it

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; gain service-worker control, set context offline, reload, and assert sample and offline state remain

claim: Workbook edits persist in browser storage
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; edit sample, wait for saved status, reload, and assert the edit remains

claim: Clearing the site's browser storage removes the saved workbook
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; create named real work, clear the product database as the browser site-data control does, reload, and assert no saved workbook remains

claim: Workbook content is not uploaded, and the app sends no analytics or third-party runtime requests
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 with request capture; edit and export; assert every request and script is same-origin, no analytics path appears, and no request body contains workbook text

claim: Keyboard shortcuts save the workbook and add a trail
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; press Control+S and Control+Enter; assert save feedback and a fourth trail

claim: Trail status identifies complete evidence and rejects malformed source URLs
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; assert three ready trails, enter malformed URL, and assert Needs evidence plus an announced repair message

claim: Shows an Install app action only when the browser permits installation
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; return to the landing page, dispatch the browser install event, invoke the visible action, and assert the prompt runs once then hides

claim: The landing illustration is original art generated for Source Trail Workbook
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; return home, fetch the served illustration, and assert the original source plus generator, prompt, date, and selection record

claim: The included host settings cache versioned assets for one year, check app files for updates, block outside scripts, and require secure connections
sandbox: clean repository; assert the shipped host configuration has one-year immutable asset caching, service-worker revalidation, self-only script policy, and one-year secure transport

claim: The included host settings send missing routes to a designed product 404 page
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; inspect the shipped 404 response mapping, open the product 404 page, and assert its title, heading, and route home

claim: The production build emits a deployable site in dist with index.html at its root
sandbox: clean repository after the claim script's production build; assert dist/index.html references a built JavaScript asset and the host configuration is present
